name: switchyard
description: Switchyard — an OpenAI-compatible LLM gateway (monorepo root)

scripts.mock: pnpm --filter switchyard-gateway exec tsx src/cli.ts mock-provider --port 8790
scripts.version-packages: changeset version && pnpm --filter switchyard-gateway run schema && pnpm install --lockfile-only
scripts.check:package: pnpm --filter switchyard-gateway run schema:check && pnpm --filter switchyard-gateway run check:api-docs && pnpm --filter switchyard-gateway run check:package
